'''''Veronica montana''''' or '''wood speedwell''' is a [[Perennial plant|perennial]] species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Plantaginaceae]].<ref name="POWO">{{cite web |title=Veronica montana L.|publisher=Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:812334-1 |work=Plants of the World Online |access-date=3 February 2021}}</ref>

== Description ==
''Veronica montana'' is a [[Perennial plant|perennial]] plant growing up to 20 cm in height. It has a sprawling growth habitat, which helps it spread across the [[forest floor]]. The plants stems are covered in tiny, soft [[Trichome|glandular hairs]]. Stems can produce roots when contact with damp soil is made. The leaves are [[Ovate (leaf)|ovate]], toothed and are also covered in hairs. They appear in symmetrical pairs along the plants stem. The plant hosts multiple lilac coloured flowers from late spring to early summer. Flowers are rather small at around 7mm across.<ref>{{Cite web |title=UK Wildflowers - Plantaginaceae - Veronica Montana, Wood Speedwell |url=https://www.uksouthwest.net/wildflowers/plantaginaceae/veronica-montana.html |access-date=2022-03-14 |website=uksouthwest.net}}</ref>

'''Similar species''' include ''[[Veronica chamaedrys]]'' (whose leaves are duller, hairier, narrower and commonly almost unstalked, with hairs usually focussed in two lines on the stems) and ''[[Veronica persica]]'' (whose flowers are solitary and emerge from the stem with the leaf stalks)

== Distribution ==
The species native range is from Europe to Western [[Transcaucasus]], Northwestern Africa.<ref name="POWO" />

The following ranges are indicated: [[Albania]], [[Algeria]], [[Austria]], [[Baltic states]], [[Belarus]], [[Belgium]], [[Bulgaria]], [[Corsica]], the [[Czech Republic]], [[Denmark]], [[France]], [[Germany]], [[Great Britain]], [[Greece]], [[Hungary]], [[Ireland]], [[Italy]], the [[Netherlands]], [[North Caucasus]], [[Poland]], [[Portugal]], [[Romania]], [[Sicily]], [[Slovakia]], [[Spain]], [[Sweden]], [[Switzerland]], [[South Caucasus]], [[Tunisia]], [[Turkey]], [[Ukraine]], [[Yugoslavia]].<ref name="POWO" />

== Habitat ==
Wood speedwell is commonly associated with long-established, damp [[deciduous]] [[woodland]], where it is generally found in lowland habitats.<ref>Clive Stace, ''New Flora of the British Isles'' 4th edition 2019, p 621</ref> ''V. montana'' is also known to inhabit areas with [[Soil pH|neutral]] to mildly [[Soil pH|acidic]] soils.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Seasonal Wild Flowers - Wood Speedwell |url=http://www.seasonalwildflowers.com/wood-speedwell.html |access-date=2022-03-14 |website=seasonalwildflowers.com}}</ref>

Another habitat it can be found is within shaded [[hedge]]rows<ref name=":0" /> where it can also find its way into [[garden]]s.

This species can grow within a wide range of [[Substrate (biology)|substrates]] from [[loam]], heavy [[clay]] and [[sand]]y soils.<ref name=":0" />
